sessions.finding: The first complete bag map exposed three things at once: a 4.8-yard 3w-to-5w overlap, a 25.3-yard fall from 5w to 2i, and an inverted middle-iron set in this sample. The detailed tables also confirm a leftward club path across woods and irons; TrackMan proves the delivery, not that an over-the-top body move caused it.
sessions.gist: First full bag map: 78 shots, 13 clubs. Out-to-in path, and now the ball too — every club measured finishes right.

sessions.finding: 5w has the longest all-shot average carry here (162.3 yd). Driver and 3w averages are pulled down by very short shots; this is a contact-repeatability session, not a new playing-yardage ladder.

On-course at Spyglass, not a range day. Chips, sand, and rough stay on this round — they do not roll into cumulative pure-hit averages. 56 shots stored with carry, path, face-to-path, smash, spin, dynamic loft, and remaining-to-hole from the shot list. Play order is the hole list, not bag order. Hole 5 56° had dashes for path/face/smash/loft — not invented. Remaining-to-hole left blank on four shots the list never showed (H5 7i, H7 9i, H7 56°, H16 3w). 18 tee was to fairway. Club speed and ball speed were on one driving overlay only and are not attached to a hole.
sessions.gist: 85 at Spyglass. FIR 8/14, GIR 1/18, 28 putts, scramble 35%. Path still left on a lot of the irons; 3-wood had the hot ones (H11 237.4 carry, smash 1.50).

sessions.setup: 49 shots · first block 3w/5w/7i · after slot (trail hand) 3w 9 + 5w 11
sessions.finding: 7-iron later block is a window, not a baseline. Shots 1–2: carry 113.5, face-to-path +8.9°. Shots 3–8 remaining: 138.2 n=5, face-to-path +3.1°, path −6.0°, smash 1.36 — five balls in an 11-yard band. Shots 9–30 remaining: 128.9 n=20, face-to-path +6.5°, path −7.6°, best 5 146.6. Ceiling went up after the window; the floor and the face-to-path went with it. Path never reached −2° the way the 3-wood did. This did not hold.
sessions.gist: 7i is a window: open 113.5 n=2 · run 138.2 n=5 · rest 128.9 n=20 / best 5 146.6. F–P 8.9 → 3.1 → 6.5. Path never to −2°.
